# A booked hour isn't a paid hour.

> Free calculator for independent mobile photo booth operators: find the real price for one event booking after setup/teardown time, travel, attendant labor, unlimited-print risk, and equipment cost, then check a price you're already considering against the breakeven.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
